rationale: All three edge-case candidates (naive/aware tzinfo mismatch scenarios at _iso, get_sessions duration, and dispatch-offset computation) were traced to their real data sources and dismissed: asyncpg returns consistently timezone-aware datetimes for timestamptz columns and clickhouse-connect returns consistently naive datetimes for DateTime64 columns, so the described per-row naive/aware mismatches cannot occur with either backend as currently wired, and no caller produces a tzinfo whose utcoffset() returns None. The acceptance lens confirms all required criteria pass (shared _iso() fix covers all four fields; no frontend file touched); two criteria remain pending-stage-7 (pytest execution, browser/Playwright filter verification) per the spec's own deferral, not failures. Standards review was not required for the compact profile, so no coverage gap is recorded. 0 findings emitted, 0 deferred, 3 dismissed as unreachable.
